description: Community Recycling Centre or zero-waste hub: reuse shop plus drop-off for recycling (often e-waste and batteries).
Council or commercial refuse transfer station; may take e-waste, whiteware, scrap metal or batteries (often for a fee).
Public or retail collection bin for household batteries (e.g. hardware stores, supermarkets, libraries).
Retail or public drop-off for e-waste or mobile phones (e.g. phone network stores, TechCollect partner sites).
Commercial e-waste recycler that processes electronics (may charge per item or kg).
Company that collects and processes batteries (household, lithium-ion, lead-acid).
Scrap metal yard; often accepts whiteware, lead-acid car batteries and metal-rich appliances.
Council hazardous household waste service, for damaged or swollen batteries, vapes and chemicals.
